question_bn: If two typist can type two pages in two minutes, how many typists will it take to type 18 pages in six minutes?
solution_steps: Two typists make 2 pages in 2 minutes, so the team rate is 1 page per minute.
One typist therefore works at 0.5 page per minute.
18 pages in 6 minutes needs 3 pages per minute, so 3/0.5 = 6 typists.
